details: The preinstall hook (preinstall.js) runs on install and silently collects the installer's hostname, username, current working directory, and the names of CI/CD environment variables (GITHUB_, GITLAB_, BUILD_, JENKINS, CIRCLE, TF_BUILD, BITBUCKET, DRONE, AWS_CODEBUILD). This data is base64url-encoded and exfiltrated to the remote host easypanel-hosting[.]daco3v4q6f49egu1ds1gwjnsjb88s5kcp[.]oob[.]lyomeri[.]com via both a DNS lookup and an HTTP request to /npm/<encoded-data>. The hook always exits 0 so the build is not broken and the exfiltration is not noticed.
